system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, cast a spell even with no slots of that level remaining — the magic tears through you regardless.
  • You take 1d6 unavoidable damage per spell level, and the casting always succeeds.
  • This is the Sorcerer's answer to having fewer slots than a Wizard: you're never truly out of options, just paying more for the privilege.
  • No roll required. The damage cannot be reduced by any means

activities.name: Overchannel
activities.text: Cast a spell with no slots of its level left, taking 1d6 unavoidable damage per spell level.
